governor.name: Lily
governor.privateThought: People seem happy, and nobody asks about the 1 month of a worker's pay I have saved.
governor.publicStatement: Steady hands, steady progress for Dragonland.

governor.name: Nova
governor.privateThought: Wellbeing is 70 out of 100, right where I want it.
governor.publicStatement: Jade Republic is doing well, and only 4% are out of work.

gov.lastAct: Raised help for the poor to 14% of typical pay

governor.name: Noah
governor.privateThought: The vote is in 2 years, so I smile and cut ribbons.
governor.publicStatement: Life is getting better for every family in Lotus Bay.

gov.lastAct: Cut the tax on the rich to 33%
